description:
A WordStar 7 style Markdown editor for the terminal.

A reimplementation of DOS WordStar 7 for the modern terminal — the blue screen, the menu bar, the ruler, the status line, and above all the control diamond and the ^K/^Q/^P command chords you already have in your fingers. Files are written as plain Markdown, so your manuscripts stay readable, portable, and future-proof.
It is built for writers who learned to compose on WordStar and never quite found anything that felt the same — but who also want arrow keys, a built-in file browser, find-and-replace, and a live formatting preview when they want them.
What's changed
- Spell checking with live underlines, ^QL / ^QN and a personal dictionary
- US English dictionary built in; other languages via installed Hunspell dictionaries
- Thesaurus (^QJ) from installed MyThes data
- Word document export (.docx), with real paragraph styles, tables and page numbers
- Standard manuscript format in the preview, the PDF and the Word export
- Headers, footers (.he / .fo) and page breaks (.pa)
- Master documents: .fi includes chapter files in the preview, PDF and word count
- US Letter paper (paper: letter)
- Smart punctuation — curly quotes, em dashes and ellipses
- Optional WordStar paragraphs (paragraphs: lines)
- ^OC centers lines in print, with .oc on/off
- Live word count on the title bar, plus word-count goal, session progress and block count in ^K?
- Go to Heading (^QG): chapter list with page numbers
- Place markers ^K0-9 / ^Q0-9, and ^QP back to the previous position
- ^QR / ^QC jump to the document ends
- WordStar find/replace options (B U W G N), with confirm-each replace undone in one step
- Persistent ^KB / ^KK blocks that follow the text as you edit
- ^KW writes a block to a file, ^KZ sorts a block's lines, and blocks change case
- Blocks are copied to the system clipboard (OSC 52 in terminals, clipboard API in browsers)
- Recent Files list, and documents reopen where you left off
- Word wrap at the ruler margin (^OR / .rm)
- Atomic saves with .bak backups, crash recovery, and guarded close / open / quit
- Undo now remembers 10,000 edits
- Bracketed paste in terminals; paste and mouse wheel in the browser
- WordStar fidelity fixes: one-press ^Y, ^N cursor, menu chords, mouse mapping
- Dependencies upgraded
